messages.content:
Risk: Opaque system architecture
Description: The AI system's internal structure and decision-making process may not be understandable or accessible to stakeholders, including developers, auditors, or end-users.
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Decision-Making

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 3/5 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000146: Artificial Language — A Language that is developed through conscious planning and premeditation, rather than one that was developed through use and repetition. [found by 3/5 queries]
  Siblings: Natural Language
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 3/5 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0033071: Impaired task monitoring — Impaired ability to keep track of one's problem-solving success or failure, and to identify and correct mistakes during performance of a goal. [found by 2/5 queries]
  Siblings: Impaired ability to plan, Impaired self monitoring, Impaired ability to organize
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0004801: automatism AE — This is an AE which refers to a set of brief unconscious behaviors. [found by 2/5 queries]
  Siblings: somnambulism AE, attention-seeking behaviour AE, somatoform disorder AE

axes.rationale: The AI system's internal structure and decision-making process may be described or documented in an artificial language, making it opaque to stakeholders.
The AI system (software agent) is the entity whose internal structure and decision-making process may not be understandable or accessible.
